title.zh: 销量翻倍的秘密：挪瓦咖啡“吨吨桶”为何能成为现象级爆款？
title.en: The Secret Behind Doubled Sales: Why Nowwa Coffee's "Ton Ton Bucket" Became a Phenomenal Hit?

summary.zh: 深入解析挪瓦咖啡标志性产品“吨吨桶”的成功逻辑。凭借大容量、低热量和极致性价比，吨吨桶不仅在社交媒体上引发热潮，更带动了全国门店销量的爆发式增长。
summary.en: An in-depth analysis of the success logic behind Nowwa Coffee's iconic "Ton Ton Bucket." With its large capacity, low calories, and ultimate cost-effectiveness, it not only sparked a craze on social media but also drove explosive sales growth in stores nationwide.

content.zh:
在竞争激烈的咖啡市场中，打造一款能够持续热销的爆款产品是每个品牌的梦想。而挪瓦咖啡（NOWWA COFFEE）的“吨吨桶”系列，无疑是近年来最成功的现象级单品之一。

据行业数据显示，挪瓦咖啡的“吨吨桶”系列（如0脂白桃乌龙吨吨桶、生椰拿铁吨吨桶等）在推出后迅速引爆市场，其销量占整体营收的比例一度超过40%。在五一等节假日期间，吨吨桶果咖的销量更是实现了惊人的同比增长，带动了数十个城市门店的销量翻倍。

“吨吨桶”之所以能取得如此巨大的成功，核心在于其精准击中了年轻消费者的三大痛点：

1. **大容量满足感**：750ml甚至1000ml的超大容量，不仅在视觉上极具冲击力，更满足了消费者在炎热夏季或长时间工作学习时的“畅饮”需求。
2. **健康低卡属性**：挪瓦咖啡坚持“低糖、健康”的理念，许多吨吨桶产品主打0脂或低卡，让消费者在享受美味的同时没有身材焦虑。
3. **极致性价比**：相比于购买两杯常规容量的咖啡，吨吨桶提供了更高的性价比，成为了打工人和学生党的“续命神器”。

此外，吨吨桶自带的“社交货币”属性，也让其在小红书、抖音等平台上获得了海量的自发传播。对于加盟商而言，这样一款自带流量、复购率极高的爆款产品，无疑是门店盈利的最强保障。

*本文内容整理自亿邦动力及相关行业媒体的深度报道。*
content.en:
In the fiercely competitive coffee market, creating a hit product that can sustain high sales is the dream of every brand. Nowwa Coffee's "Ton Ton Bucket" series is undoubtedly one of the most successful phenomenal items in recent years.

According to industry data, Nowwa Coffee's "Ton Ton Bucket" series (such as the 0-Fat White Peach Oolong Ton Ton Bucket, Raw Coconut Latte Ton Ton Bucket, etc.) quickly ignited the market after its launch, with its sales accounting for over 40% of total revenue at one point. During holidays like May Day, the sales of fruit coffee Ton Ton Buckets achieved astonishing year-on-year growth, driving doubled sales in stores across dozens of cities.

The core reason why the "Ton Ton Bucket" achieved such massive success lies in its precise targeting of three major pain points of young consumers:

1. **Large Capacity Satisfaction**: The super-large capacity of 750ml or even 1000ml is not only visually striking but also satisfies consumers' need for "unlimited drinking" during hot summers or long hours of work and study.
2. **Healthy and Low-Calorie Attributes**: Nowwa Coffee adheres to the concept of "low sugar, healthy." Many Ton Ton Bucket products feature 0-fat or low calories, allowing consumers to enjoy delicious drinks without body anxiety.
3. **Ultimate Cost-Effectiveness**: Compared to buying two regular-sized coffees, the Ton Ton Bucket offers higher cost-effectiveness, becoming a "life-saving artifact" for office workers and students.

In addition, the inherent "social currency" attribute of the Ton Ton Bucket has also earned it massive spontaneous sharing on platforms like Xiaohongshu and TikTok. For franchisees, such a hit product with its own traffic and extremely high repurchase rate is undoubtedly the strongest guarantee for store profitability.

*This article is compiled from in-depth reports by Ebrun and related industry media.*

title.zh: 斩获22项IIAC金奖！揭秘挪瓦咖啡的“冠军级”咖啡豆
title.en: Winner of 22 IIAC Gold Medals! Unveiling Nowwa Coffee's "Champion-Level" Coffee Beans

summary.zh: 挪瓦咖啡始终坚持“好豆子才有好咖啡”的理念。自成立以来，其精选咖啡豆已累计斩获22项IIAC国际咖啡品鉴大赛金奖，为每一杯果咖提供世界级的品质保障。
summary.en: Nowwa Coffee consistently adheres to the philosophy that "good beans make good coffee." Since its inception, its selected coffee beans have won a total of 22 gold medals at the IIAC International Coffee Tasting Competition, providing world-class quality assurance for every cup of fruit coffee.

content.zh:
在咖啡行业，IIAC（国际咖啡品鉴者协会）举办的国际咖啡品鉴大赛被誉为“咖啡界的奥斯卡”。能够在这一赛事中斩获金奖，是全球咖啡品牌梦寐以求的荣誉。而中国本土品牌挪瓦咖啡（NOWWA COFFEE），却在这个国际舞台上屡创佳绩。

据最新统计，挪瓦咖啡自成立以来，其选用的多款咖啡豆已累计斩获了惊人的22项IIAC金奖。这一成绩不仅在国内咖啡品牌中名列前茅，更向世界展示了中国咖啡品牌的硬核实力。

挪瓦咖啡之所以能够屡获殊荣，源于其对“好豆子才有好咖啡”理念的极致追求。品牌在全球范围内甄选优质咖啡豆产区，从源头把控品质。同时，挪瓦咖啡组建了专业的寻豆师和烘焙师团队，针对不同风味的果咖产品，进行定制化的烘焙曲线研发，确保每一颗咖啡豆都能释放出最佳的风味。

在挪瓦咖啡的门店中，无论是经典的拿铁、美式，还是创新的果咖系列，其基底都采用了这些荣获IIAC金奖的咖啡豆。这种对品质的毫不妥协，不仅赢得了消费者的口碑，也为加盟商提供了强大的产品竞争力。当您在加拿大品尝一杯挪瓦咖啡时，您享受的正是这世界级的“冠军风味”。

*本文内容整理自新浪财经及相关行业媒体的公开报道。*
content.en:
In the coffee industry, the International Coffee Tasting Competition organized by the IIAC (International Institute of Coffee Tasters) is known as the "Oscars of the Coffee World." Winning a gold medal in this event is a highly coveted honor for global coffee brands. However, the Chinese local brand Nowwa Coffee has repeatedly achieved outstanding results on this international stage.

According to the latest statistics, since its establishment, the various coffee beans selected by Nowwa Coffee have won an astonishing total of 22 IIAC gold medals. This achievement not only ranks among the top domestic coffee brands but also demonstrates the hardcore strength of Chinese coffee brands to the world.

The reason Nowwa Coffee has won numerous awards stems from its ultimate pursuit of the philosophy that "good beans make good coffee." The brand selects high-quality coffee bean producing areas globally, controlling quality from the source. At the same time, Nowwa Coffee has assembled a professional team of bean hunters and roasters to develop customized roasting curves for different flavored fruit coffee products, ensuring that every coffee bean can release its best flavor.

In Nowwa Coffee stores, whether it's classic lattes, Americanos, or innovative fruit coffee series, their bases all use these IIAC gold medal-winning coffee beans. This uncompromising attitude towards quality has not only won word-of-mouth from consumers but also provided franchisees with strong product competitiveness. When you taste a cup of Nowwa Coffee in Canada, you are enjoying this world-class "champion flavor."

*This article is compiled from public reports by Sina Finance and related industry media.*

title.zh: 4倍增速领跑行业：挪瓦咖啡“轻资产联营模式”的盈利密码
title.en: Leading the Industry with 4x Growth: The Profitability Code of Nowwa Coffee's "Asset-Light Franchise Model"

summary.zh: 在咖啡行业竞争白热化的今天，挪瓦咖啡凭借独创的“店中店”联营模式，大幅降低开店成本，实现单店高坪效与快速回本，成为众多加盟商的首选。
summary.en: In today's fiercely competitive coffee industry, Nowwa Coffee has significantly reduced store opening costs and achieved high sales per square meter and rapid payback through its original "store-in-store" franchise model, making it the top choice for many franchisees.

content.zh:
近年来，中国咖啡市场迎来了前所未有的爆发期，各大品牌为了争夺市场份额，纷纷开启了“跑马圈地”的扩张模式。然而，在行业普遍面临“增收不增利”困境的背景下，挪瓦咖啡（NOWWA COFFEE）却交出了一份令人瞩目的答卷：全年GMV同比增长高达4倍，门店数量突破万家。

挪瓦咖啡之所以能够实现如此惊人的逆势增长，其核心密码在于独创的“轻资产联营模式”。

传统的咖啡店往往需要高昂的租金、装修和设备投入，回本周期长，风险较高。而挪瓦咖啡另辟蹊径，主打“店中店”模式。通过与便利店（如美宜佳）、网吧、健身房、烘焙店等现有业态进行深度合作，挪瓦咖啡将门店嵌入到这些自带流量的场景中。

这种模式带来了显著的优势：
1. **极低的初始投入**：加盟商无需承担高昂的独立门店租金和装修费用，单店初始投入大幅降低。
2. **共享客流与高坪效**：借助合作方的现有客流，挪瓦咖啡能够迅速实现冷启动，并在极小的面积内创造出极高的坪效。
3. **快速回本与盈利**：低成本加上高复购率的爆款产品（如吨吨桶），使得挪瓦咖啡联营店的回本周期远低于行业平均水平。

对于加拿大市场的潜在投资者而言，挪瓦咖啡这种经过万店验证的成熟盈利模式，无疑提供了一个低风险、高回报的优质创业选择。

*本文内容整理自第一财经及相关商业媒体的深度报道。*
content.en:
In recent years, the Chinese coffee market has ushered in an unprecedented period of explosion. Major brands have launched "land-grabbing" expansion models to compete for market share. However, against the backdrop of the industry generally facing the dilemma of "increasing revenue without increasing profit," Nowwa Coffee delivered a remarkable answer: annual GMV grew by up to 4 times year-on-year, and the number of stores surpassed 10,000.

The core code behind Nowwa Coffee's astonishing counter-trend growth lies in its original "asset-light franchise model."

Traditional coffee shops often require high rent, decoration, and equipment investments, with long payback periods and high risks. Nowwa Coffee took a different approach, focusing on the "store-in-store" model. By deeply cooperating with existing formats such as convenience stores (like Meiyijia), internet cafes, gyms, and bakeries, Nowwa Coffee embeds its stores into these scenarios that come with their own traffic.

This model brings significant advantages:
1. **Extremely Low Initial Investment**: Franchisees do not need to bear the high rent and decoration costs of independent stores, significantly reducing the initial investment for a single store.
2. **Shared Traffic and High Sales Per Square Meter**: Leveraging the partner's existing traffic, Nowwa Coffee can quickly achieve a cold start and create extremely high sales per square meter within a very small area.
3. **Rapid Payback and Profitability**: Low costs coupled with hit products with high repurchase rates (such as the Ton Ton Bucket) make the payback period of Nowwa Coffee franchise stores far lower than the industry average.

For potential investors in the Canadian market, Nowwa Coffee's mature profitability model, verified by 10,000 stores, undoubtedly provides a high-quality entrepreneurial choice with low risk and high returns.

*This article is compiled from in-depth reports by Yicai and related business media.*

title.zh: 开启“0脂时代”：挪瓦咖啡如何用健康果咖重塑年轻人的消费习惯
title.en: Ushering in the "Zero-Fat Era": How Nowwa Coffee Reshapes Young Consumers' Habits with Healthy Fruit Coffee

summary.zh: 积极响应健康生活趋势，挪瓦咖啡推出全球首创的0脂拿铁及超级果蔬季系列产品，将“低糖、低卡”理念完美融入日常咖啡消费，引领行业新风潮。
summary.en: Actively responding to the trend of healthy living, Nowwa Coffee launched the world's first 0-fat latte and the super fruit and vegetable season series products, perfectly integrating the concepts of "low sugar and low calories" into daily coffee consumption, leading a new industry trend.

content.zh:
随着全球消费者对健康饮食的关注度日益提升，“减糖、控脂”已经成为餐饮行业不可逆转的大趋势。作为健康咖啡赛道的领跑者，挪瓦咖啡（NOWWA COFFEE）敏锐地捕捉到了这一需求变化，并以一系列创新产品引领咖啡行业进入“0脂时代”。

2025年9月，挪瓦咖啡重磅推出了全球首创的“0脂拿铁”。这款产品打破了传统拿铁高热量、高脂肪的刻板印象，通过采用创新的0脂乳原料，在保留拿铁醇厚口感的同时，实现了真正的零脂肪摄入。这一突破性创新，立刻在注重身材管理的年轻消费者群体中引发了强烈反响。

除了0脂拿铁，挪瓦咖啡还持续深耕“果咖”领域，推出了“超级果蔬季”系列产品。例如，羽衣甘蓝轻咖、红石榴美式、西梅益生菌美式等爆款饮品，将新鲜果蔬的营养与咖啡的提神功效完美结合。这些产品不仅色彩诱人、口感清爽，更重要的是，它们主打低糖、低卡，完美契合了现代人追求健康生活方式的诉求。

挪瓦咖啡的成功，在于它不仅仅是在卖一杯咖啡，更是在倡导一种健康、轻盈的生活态度。这种对健康理念的坚持，不仅让挪瓦咖啡在竞争激烈的市场中形成了鲜明的差异化优势，也为其在注重健康饮食的加拿大市场赢得了广阔的发展前景。

*本文内容整理自知乎专栏及相关健康消费媒体的报道。*
content.en:
As global consumers pay increasing attention to healthy diets, "sugar reduction and fat control" have become an irreversible major trend in the food and beverage industry. As a leader in the healthy coffee track, Nowwa Coffee keenly captured this demand change and led the coffee industry into the "Zero-Fat Era" with a series of innovative products.

In September 2025, Nowwa Coffee heavily launched the world's first "0-Fat Latte." This product broke the stereotype of traditional lattes being high in calories and fat. By using innovative 0-fat milk raw materials, it achieved true zero fat intake while retaining the mellow taste of a latte. This breakthrough innovation immediately triggered a strong response among young consumers who focus on body management.

In addition to the 0-fat latte, Nowwa Coffee continues to deeply cultivate the "fruit coffee" field, launching the "Super Fruit and Vegetable Season" series of products. For example, hit drinks like Kale Light Coffee, Red Pomegranate Americano, and Prune Probiotic Americano perfectly combine the nutrition of fresh fruits and vegetables with the refreshing effect of coffee. These products are not only visually appealing and refreshing in taste, but more importantly, they feature low sugar and low calories, perfectly matching modern people's demands for a healthy lifestyle.

The success of Nowwa Coffee lies in the fact that it is not just selling a cup of coffee, but advocating a healthy and light life attitude. This adherence to health concepts has not only allowed Nowwa Coffee to form a distinct differentiated advantage in the fiercely competitive market but also won it broad development prospects in the Canadian market, which values healthy eating.

*This article is compiled from reports by Zhihu Column and related health consumption media.*

title.zh: 登上央视的咖啡品牌：挪瓦咖啡如何通过跨界营销实现品牌破圈
title.en: A Coffee Brand Featured on CCTV: How Nowwa Coffee Achieves Brand Breakthrough via Cross-Boundary Marketing

summary.zh: 从联名热门IP到荣登CCTV央视报道，挪瓦咖啡凭借敏锐的市场嗅觉和创新的营销玩法，不断打破圈层壁垒，将品牌影响力推向新的高度。
summary.en: From co-branding with popular IPs to being featured on CCTV, Nowwa Coffee continuously breaks through circle barriers and pushes its brand influence to new heights with its keen market sense and innovative marketing plays.

content.zh:
在信息碎片化的时代，品牌如何才能在海量信息中脱颖而出，抓住消费者的眼球？挪瓦咖啡（NOWWA COFFEE）给出的答案是：持续的跨界创新与高举高打的品牌势能。

2025年夏季，挪瓦咖啡凭借其爆款产品“吨吨桶”和“超级果蔬季”系列，成功吸引了国家级权威媒体的关注，荣登CCTV-2央视财经频道。央视的报道不仅肯定了挪瓦咖啡在产品创新上的努力，更高度评价了其积极响应国家体重管理行动、倡导健康生活方式的社会责任感。这一权威背书，极大地提升了挪瓦咖啡的品牌公信力和国民知名度。

除了获得权威媒体的认可，挪瓦咖啡在年轻化营销方面同样玩得风生水起。品牌不仅邀请了口碑极佳的明星（如曹骏）担任品牌大使，更在抖音、小红书等社交平台上发起了多场现象级的直播和互动活动。例如，在炎热的夏季，品牌大使亲自在线下为粉丝送上清凉的吨吨桶，线上直播间则通过创新的场景化营销（如制作粉色气泡美式），吸引了数以百万计的年轻用户参与。

这种“权威背书+年轻化互动”的双轮驱动营销策略，让挪瓦咖啡成功打破了传统的圈层壁垒，实现了品牌的全面破圈。对于加盟商而言，强大的品牌势能意味着自带的流量和更高的转化率，这也是挪瓦咖啡能够在全国乃至全球范围内快速扩张的重要引擎。

*本文内容整理自搜狐新闻及相关权威媒体的报道。*
content.en:
In the era of fragmented information, how can a brand stand out from the massive amount of information and catch consumers' eyes? The answer given by Nowwa Coffee is: continuous cross-boundary innovation and high-profile brand momentum.

In the summer of 2025, Nowwa Coffee successfully attracted the attention of national authoritative media with its hit products "Ton Ton Bucket" and the "Super Fruit and Vegetable Season" series, and was featured on CCTV-2 (China Central Television's financial channel). CCTV's report not only affirmed Nowwa Coffee's efforts in product innovation but also highly praised its social responsibility in actively responding to the national weight management action and advocating a healthy lifestyle. This authoritative endorsement greatly enhanced Nowwa Coffee's brand credibility and national awareness.

In addition to gaining recognition from authoritative media, Nowwa Coffee is also playing exceptionally well in youth-oriented marketing. The brand not only invited highly reputed celebrities (such as Cao Jun) to serve as brand ambassadors but also launched multiple phenomenal live streams and interactive activities on social platforms like TikTok and Xiaohongshu. For example, during the hot summer, the brand ambassador personally delivered refreshing Ton Ton Buckets to fans offline, while the online live broadcast room attracted millions of young users to participate through innovative scenario-based marketing (such as making pink sparkling Americanos).

This dual-engine marketing strategy of "authoritative endorsement + youth-oriented interaction" has allowed Nowwa Coffee to successfully break traditional circle barriers and achieve a comprehensive brand breakthrough. For franchisees, strong brand momentum means built-in traffic and higher conversion rates, which is also an important engine for Nowwa Coffee's rapid expansion nationwide and even globally.

*This article is compiled from reports by Sohu News and related authoritative media.*

title.zh: 为什么果咖在加拿大越来越受欢迎？挪瓦咖啡的北美新机遇
title.en: Why is Fruit Coffee Becoming Increasingly Popular in Canada? Nowwa Coffee's New Opportunities in North America

summary.zh: 随着加拿大消费者对健康饮品需求的日益增长，主打低糖果咖的挪瓦咖啡迎来了巨大的市场机遇。独特的口感与成熟的商业模式，正吸引着越来越多的本地投资者。
summary.en: As Canadian consumers' demand for healthy beverages grows day by day, Nowwa Coffee, which focuses on low-sugar fruit coffee, has ushered in huge market opportunities. Its unique taste and mature business model are attracting more and more local investors.

content.zh:
加拿大是一个拥有深厚咖啡文化的国家，从街角的独立咖啡馆到遍布全国的连锁巨头，咖啡早已成为加拿大人生活中不可或缺的一部分。然而，随着年轻一代消费者健康意识的觉醒，传统的重度烘焙、高糖高奶的咖啡饮品正面临着新的挑战。在这一背景下，“果咖”作为一种新兴的细分品类，正在加拿大市场迅速崛起。

果咖，顾名思义，是将新鲜水果的风味与咖啡的醇香完美融合。它不仅在口感上更加清爽、层次丰富，更重要的是，它天然契合了现代人追求“低糖、低卡、健康”的饮食趋势。作为全球果咖赛道的领军品牌，挪瓦咖啡（NOWWA COFFEE）敏锐地洞察到了加拿大市场的这一巨大潜力。

挪瓦咖啡进军加拿大市场，带来了其在国内经过万店验证的成熟产品矩阵。无论是荣获IIAC金奖的经典咖啡豆，还是风靡社交网络的“吨吨桶”系列，亦或是主打0脂健康的创新饮品，都为加拿大消费者提供了全新的咖啡体验。更重要的是，挪瓦咖啡独特的“轻资产联营模式”，为加拿大本地的创业者和投资者提供了一个低门槛、高回报的商业机会。

我们相信，凭借卓越的产品力和创新的商业模式，挪瓦咖啡必将在加拿大掀起一场健康果咖的新风潮，与众多城市合伙人一起，共同书写北美市场的新篇章。

*本文由 Nowwa Coffee Canada 官方团队撰写发布。*
content.en:
Canada is a country with a profound coffee culture. From independent cafes on street corners to chain giants spread across the country, coffee has long become an indispensable part of Canadians' lives. However, with the awakening of health consciousness among the younger generation of consumers, traditional heavily roasted, high-sugar, and high-milk coffee drinks are facing new challenges. Against this backdrop, "fruit coffee," as an emerging sub-category, is rapidly rising in the Canadian market.

Fruit coffee, as the name suggests, perfectly blends the flavor of fresh fruits with the mellow aroma of coffee. It is not only more refreshing and richly layered in taste, but more importantly, it naturally fits the modern dietary trend of pursuing "low sugar, low calories, and health." As a leading brand in the global fruit coffee track, Nowwa Coffee keenly perceived this huge potential in the Canadian market.

Nowwa Coffee's entry into the Canadian market brings its mature product matrix verified by 10,000 stores domestically. Whether it's the classic coffee beans that won the IIAC gold medal, the "Ton Ton Bucket" series that swept social networks, or the innovative drinks focusing on 0-fat health, they all provide Canadian consumers with a brand-new coffee experience. More importantly, Nowwa Coffee's unique "asset-light franchise model" provides local entrepreneurs and investors in Canada with a low-barrier, high-return business opportunity.

We believe that with outstanding product strength and an innovative business model, Nowwa Coffee will surely set off a new trend of healthy fruit coffee in Canada, and together with many city partners, write a new chapter in the North American market.

*This article is written and published by the Nowwa Coffee Canada official team.*

title.zh: 从零到一：一家挪瓦咖啡联营店的成功日记与盈利之道
title.en: From Zero to One: The Success Diary and Profitability Path of a Nowwa Coffee Franchise Store

summary.zh: 探秘一家普通挪瓦咖啡联营店的成长历程。通过总部的全方位扶持、标准化的运营流程以及爆款产品的引流，新手店长也能轻松实现稳定盈利。
summary.en: Explore the growth journey of an ordinary Nowwa Coffee franchise store. Through comprehensive support from the headquarters, standardized operational processes, and traffic driven by hit products, even novice store managers can easily achieve stable profitability.

content.zh:
“开一家属于自己的咖啡店”，是许多年轻人的梦想。但面对高昂的租金、复杂的供应链和激烈的竞争，这个梦想往往让人望而却步。然而，对于90后创业者李先生来说，选择加盟挪瓦咖啡（NOWWA COFFEE），让他的梦想不仅照进了现实，更成为了一门赚钱的好生意。

李先生的挪瓦咖啡店开在一家大型连锁便利店的内部，这正是挪瓦咖啡主打的“店中店”联营模式。回忆起开店初期的经历，李先生感慨万分：“我之前完全没有餐饮经验，最担心的就是选址和运营。但挪瓦总部的扶持非常到位，从前期的商圈评估、店面设计，到后期的设备采购、员工培训，几乎是手把手教我怎么做。”

得益于“店中店”模式，李先生的初始投资成本极低，且开业第一天就享受到了便利店自带的庞大客流。更让他惊喜的是挪瓦咖啡强大的产品力。“总部的研发团队非常给力，每个月都有新品上市。特别是夏天的‘吨吨桶’系列，简直是引流神器，很多顾客都是冲着它来的，复购率非常高。”

通过标准化的SOP（标准作业程序）和智能化的门店管理系统，李先生一个人就能轻松管理好这家小店。开业不到半年，这家不到10平米的联营店就已经实现了稳定盈利，回本速度远超他的预期。

李先生的成功故事，只是挪瓦咖啡万家门店中的一个缩影。它证明了，在一个成熟的商业模式和强大的品牌赋能下，即使是零经验的创业者，也能在咖啡赛道中分得一杯羹。

*本文内容基于对挪瓦咖啡真实加盟商的采访整理。*
content.en:
"Opening my own coffee shop" is the dream of many young people. But faced with high rent, complex supply chains, and fierce competition, this dream is often daunting. However, for Mr. Li, a post-90s entrepreneur, choosing to franchise with Nowwa Coffee not only turned his dream into reality but also made it a profitable business.

Mr. Li's Nowwa Coffee shop is located inside a large chain convenience store, which is exactly the "store-in-store" franchise model that Nowwa Coffee focuses on. Recalling his experience in the early days of opening the store, Mr. Li was full of emotion: "I had absolutely no food and beverage experience before, and my biggest worries were site selection and operations. But the support from Nowwa's headquarters was very thorough. From early business district evaluation and store design to later equipment procurement and staff training, they practically taught me hand-in-hand."

Thanks to the "store-in-store" model, Mr. Li's initial investment cost was extremely low, and he enjoyed the massive traffic brought by the convenience store on the very first day of opening. What surprised him even more was Nowwa Coffee's strong product power. "The headquarters' R&D team is very awesome, with new products launched every month. Especially the 'Ton Ton Bucket' series in summer, it's simply a traffic-driving artifact. Many customers come specifically for it, and the repurchase rate is very high."

Through standardized SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) and an intelligent store management system, Mr. Li can easily manage this small shop by himself. Less than half a year after opening, this franchise store of less than 10 square meters has already achieved stable profitability, and the payback speed far exceeded his expectations.

Mr. Li's success story is just a microcosm of Nowwa Coffee's 10,000 stores. It proves that under a mature business model and strong brand empowerment, even zero-experience entrepreneurs can get a piece of the pie in the coffee track.

*This article is compiled based on interviews with real Nowwa Coffee franchisees.*
